name: Nippon Rietec Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Rietec Co.,Ltd. engages in the railway electrical equipment construction business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Electrical Equipment Construction; Sideline; and Real Estate Rental. The company offers signal equipment, train track equipment, power generation and transformation equipment, electric light and power equipment, and information and communication system constructions, as well as transmission line equipment. It also constructs signage and landscape signs, traffic signals, and road information control systems.
